claim: Audit baseline recorded at commit 9d6a0b24d425318169c27746103014d1d1a0a2a5; Go, Python, and Ansible were available; ansible-lint and HAProxy were missing.
Go vet, formatting check, controlplane module build, Python compilation/unit tests, and Bash syntax checks passed.
The root README command go build ./controlplane fails because the repository root module does not contain that nested module package.
The ordinary Go test run produced 211 passing test result events, with no failures or skips.
The standalone Go race test invocation exceeded the 300-second outer timeout; scripts/run-all-tests.sh separately reported its race step passing.
scripts/recycle-test.sh passed and scripts/run-all-tests.sh reported 7/7 checks passing.
Mock stress provisioned 12 of 12 teams with unique IPs and 9 sync events, but the quarantine-to-FREE check did not pass within 120 seconds.

After a copy-only provisioner initialization adjustment, the mock API returned expected auth statuses, provisioned idempotently, validated payloads, extended TTL, tore down, quarantined, and reclaimed leases.
A rate limit of three allowed the first three mutating requests and returned 429 for the fourth; CORS_ORIGIN preflight included ACAO.
External team1 and team2 sandbox rows were refused teardown with 403, remained ACTIVE, and each emitted exactly one TEARDOWN_REFUSED event.
Twelve concurrent mock API provisions returned ACTIVE with unique sandbox IPs.
Generated HAProxy config omits the loopback 127.0.0.1:9000 health frontend required by the template and Keepalived check script.
Non-mock health probes default to direct TCP 80, but sandbox ingress allows TCP 80 only from the gateway security group.
The default gateway regression window is 45 seconds, conflicting with the requested sub-second auto-rollback target; deployments and probes increase total time.
A PROVISIONING sandbox was included in generated public frontend ACLs and backend configuration.
IPAM and gateway state stores can open different SQLite files; failover events are recorded through the gateway store DB.
ADMIN_TOKEN wraps routes that additionally require CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN or EVENTS_TOKEN/subnet authorization; X-Events-Token alone is rejected, and DASHBOARD_ORIGIN does not configure CORS.

Failover code tests an observed VIP transition and restores Keepalived, but downtime starts only at the first failed probe; if the first probe sees the peer already serving, reported downtime remains zero.

The second manual rollback selected the BAD_CONFIG snapshot after the first rollback selected GOOD_CONFIG; no-prior rollback made no deployment/generation change; failed deployment triggered a fake auto-rollback redeploy.
Local IP allocation begins at subnet network address plus two and does not query Neutron before selecting; a real Neutron collision was not attempted.
failoverMu protects manual HTTP operations but is not taken by CLI, provision, teardown/reaper, or add/remove-team sync call paths.

README/API docs and .env.example contradict code on rollback placeholder status, root build command, default port, token and CORS names, duplicate provision timeout, default hostname, and rollback HTTP error status; the seven local check count is consistent.
evidence: README.md; docs/api-gateways.md; .env.example; TEST_PLAN.md; controlplane sources; raw/phase1.txt

Gateway sync/rollback/failover endpoints do not enforce the strict JSON decoder or body-size cap; valid unknown-field and 2 MiB bodies reached processing on all three routes.
No dashboard frontend exists in the repository; backend endpoints are available for sandbox, lease, event, gateway state, provisioning, lifecycle, reconcile, sync, rollback, and failover operations.
No pitch deck or demo video was found; README and technical/API documentation exist.
No OpenStack, gateway, bastion, or live performance verification is claimed; an initial unshimmed Ansible sync request may have reached infrastructure and its reachability cannot be established.
